== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ウーキーとキスする方がましだわ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">相手がカードを配備した直後に使用する。3フォース消費してそのカードを相手の手札に戻させる。そのカードを配備するのに消費したフォースは消費されたままとなる。次の相手のターンに、そのカードは不可能でない限り、必ず同じロケーションに配備されなければならない。この際、配備にフォースは消費しない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「まあせいぜい楽しみな。お熱いやつな」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee.

'''Lore''' — Well, enjoy it as much as you can. You passionate one.

'''Game text''' — Play immediately after the opponent deploys a card. Spend 3 Force to return that card to the opponent's hand. Force spent to deploy that card remains spent. On the opponent's next turn, that card must be deployed to the same location unless that is impossible. Force is not spent for that deploy.

One asterisk precedes the title. Timing is 配備した直後. Redeploy is 同じロケーション and フォースは消費しない, matching original print, not the later same-target errata. Immediate Effects are not excepted.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-idjustassoonkissawookiee-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]].</ref>
